caption:
Arches & leather.

A barbershop drawn around a row of arched mirrors, each lit along its edge, with cognac leather chairs against olive-taupe walls. At the back, a curved sofa and nested marble tables make the wait part of the visit, under backlit display shelving.

Interior design & 3D visualization by KAÏRA Interior Design.
